definitions.explanation: A picture made by cutting shapes out of paper, often black paper laid over white or colored paper. A hobby, an art form, and a common school craft.

examples.japanese: {切|き}り{絵|え}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{切|き}り{絵|え}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a paper-cut picture from black paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧{切|き}り{絵|え}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦カッターナイフ→カッターナイフ：25729_kattaanaifu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}いて→切り抜く：06054_kirinuku⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: A detailed paper-cut picture is finished by cutting away the paper bit by bit with a craft knife.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {切|き}り{紙|がみ}: cutting folded paper into patterns, a children's craft; {切|き}り{絵|え} is a picture
- {影絵|かげえ}: shadow pictures made with light, such as shadow puppets

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{絵|え}⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: paper-cut artist
- {切|き}り{絵|え}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to mount a paper-cut picture
